scope: Read-only application review with isolated local behavior probes; runtime implementation unchanged; no live API, account or deployment actions.

backend_probe.scope: Local ASGI/SQLite behavior and statement-count probe; not PostgreSQL/network capacity

native_probe.error: Track search is busy. Retry or narrow your filters.
native_probe.scope: Native headless real TrackBrowser, fixture HTTP 503 responses

findings.finding: One discovery semaphore is acquired before body receipt and held through the endpoint; an unfinished anonymous body excludes other discovery requests in the process.
findings.suggestion: Separate small cursor requests and bulk initial collection uploads with bounded memory/query admission; add stall protection before scarce query slots are held.

findings.finding: Carousel refresh calls request_visible after failed pages; the adapter has no error or retry deadline guard, so the same failed prefetch can repeat every response.
findings.suggestion: Pause automatic fetches after failure, honor Retry-After, and use a bounded retry policy with jitter and account/query/navigation cancellation.

findings.finding: Cleanup deletes expired rows but its work is omitted from step() return value, permitting one-second idle sleeps while maintenance has work.
findings.suggestion: Report cleanup progress/backlog to daemon scheduling; reserve bounded maintenance capacity and alert on oldest expired row age.

findings.finding: An anonymous fresh name view executes 30 SQLite statements versus 7 on its next cursor page, including 16 separate pending-receipt lag reads. PostgreSQL also sends individual timeout-setting statements.
findings.suggestion: Batch indexed per-partition lag probes into one round trip and retain conservative freshness/deadline semantics.

findings.finding: Frozen page selection still joins source tracks, players and versions even though current authority is checked during hydration. Random fetches 257 wide candidates before slot rejection and then performs an extra head lookup per sample batch.
findings.suggestion: Benchmark projection-only key selection followed by authoritative hydration, narrower Random probes and a combined sampled row/head query; preserve frozen membership and exact uniformity.

findings.finding: Arbitrary substring/filter combinations have no generic sublinear scan guarantee. A two-character miss exhausted the earlier million-row probe and returned 503 after 2550.982ms. Authentication, pool waits and final commit are outside the query work-budget block.
findings.suggestion: Define an indexed strategy for terms without useful trigrams, separately admit expensive search/Random work and account for all request stages in latency objectives.
findings.limitation: The million-row probe predates the final frozen-membership, scheduler, Unicode-width and scoped-cache edits.

findings.finding: The final local 10k-receipt burst generated 93,868,224 WAL bytes including rank flush/cleanup; changed entries carry many indexes and exact seven-day distinct player/track pairs can greatly exceed catalogue size.
findings.suggestion: Measure table/index/WAL growth and vacuum under sustained skewed production-shaped traffic; optimize batched writes, redundant indexes and checkpoint writes only after profiling. Test many creators/accounts, recent pairs, personal collections, expiry, deletion and migration/backfill separately.

limitations: SQLite/ASGI behavior and statement counts do not measure concurrent PostgreSQL/cloud HTTP capacity.
Native retry probe uses the real TrackBrowser and adapter with a fixture client returning 503 once per frame. This is an attempt count, not an HTTP QPS benchmark.
Initial native control stayed in the default list view and did not exercise the carousel; final probe explicitly opens the carousel.
Headless Godot logged an unavailable Windows root certificate store; fixture networking is disabled and no TLS or live HTTP call was performed.
No new authorization bypass identified in this limited discovery review; not a complete security audit.
No end-to-end p95/p99, source backfill throughput, sustained vacuum/WAL/storage or 500-million-account certification.
